official_source_url.value: https://evisa.sl/ — confirmed as the official Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa portal (cross-referenced from slid.gov.sl). The portal requires login/application-flow access to view photo specification text; its public FAQ path returned 404 and the landing page exposes only navigation (no requirement text) to an unauthenticated fetch, so no photo size/background/format could be confirmed from this session.
